Statistics and clustering functions

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `confusion_matrix(arg0: Sequence[int], arg1: Sequence[int]) -> dict` | Compute confusion matrix |
| `dbscan(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], eps: float, min_samples: int = 5) -> dict` | DBSCAN clustering |
| `gmm(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], n_components: int, cov_type: str = 'full') -> dict` | Gaussian Mixture Model |
| `kmeans(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], k: int, max_iter: int = 300, init: str = 'kmeans++') -> dict` | K-Means clustering |
| `pca(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], n_components: int = 2) -> dict` | Principal Component Analysis |
| `roc(arg0: Sequence[int], arg1: Sequence[float]) -> dict` | ROC curve and AUC |
| `silhouette(arg0: Sequence[Sequence[float]], arg1: Sequence[int]) -> float` | Silhouette score |
| `tsne(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], n_dims: int = 2, perplexity: int = 30) -> list[list[float]]` | t-SNE embedding |
